lina: OMG Milo!!! :heart_eyes: he's a little freight train

devon: not a pet but my plant did a new leaf sprout so close enough 🌿

lina: giphy-bot: :corgi_dance: (gif)
devon: pro corgi tip: squeaky toy + hallway = conga line
chris: challenge accepted, will try to record Noodle chasing a laser later

lina: 1
devon: 3 (fight me)
